pr_title: DDL: Remove TiFlash replica progress etcd dependency
pr_body:

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #38464

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?
Update TiFlash replica progress in the cache in DDL owner, avoiding the impact on ETCD in the case of many tables.
Send cop request to DDL owner to get TiFlash replica progress when query `information_schema.tiflash_replica`.

issue_context.title: It's no need to store TiFlash replica progress in ETCD.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We can just get progress from the cache in DDL owner, avoiding the impact on ETCD in the case of many tables like this issue: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/37168.

review_comments:
Prefer type-strong enums:

```go
type ClusterTableCopDestination int

const (
    AllTiDB ClusterTableCopDestination = iota
    DDLOwner
)
```
Just an idea, not sure: maybe you can set `flen` for the column (which stipulates how many digits we have), to avoid manual truncating.
